categories.name: utils
categories.evidence: Modifies shared BIP-352 cryptographic and parsing helper primitives in src/common/bip352.cpp.
categories.rationale: Fixes a pubkey extraction vulnerability in BIP-352 silent payments where third-party malleated scriptSigs cause wallets to scan using the wrong pubkey and miss incoming payments. Project Loupe discovered that opcodes failing real validation bypass the dummy signature checker used during extraction, leaving an attacker-controlled pubkey on top of the stack while remaining consensus-valid.
